texts: Rico Dowdle is out for Thursday night at CLE. Toe, walking boot, no practice all week. Jaylen Warren is a start as an RB1 in PPR. Let's get to it. #HereWeGo #DawgPound

Warren played 90 percent of the snaps and had 20 touches the last time Dowdle sat, and Pittsburgh ran two tight ends on most snaps vs CIN, so the checkdowns run through the back. Start Warren as an RB1 at CLE. #HereWeGo

Dowdle is off the Menu and Warren's row carries the change. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for every Thursday night call, and like this if it fixed your lineup.
